sequence.description: The last engine event applied to the book.

at.description: The engine clock when the book was read.

bookVersionSchema.description: The engine version an exchange's book was captured at, the same `asOf` the realtime book push carries. Versions compare by `sequence`, then `at`. Null when the book was read from the database, which has no version.

conclusion: BookVersion.at is engine read time; this investigation does not justify removing source-age checks.
